blocks.content: HP LaserJet Pro M501; HP LaserJet Enterprise M506, M507 and MFP M527, MFP M528; HP LaserJet Managed E50045 and MFP E52545; HP LaserJet Managed E50145 and MFP E52645 - Service Manual: Repair

Learn how to remove and replace supported service parts on the printer. Parts are either customer-self repair (CSR) replaceable, or field replaceable units (FRUs) which require installation by a trained field-service technician. Use the provided parts diagrams and tables to identify the required part. For printer theory and troubleshooting information, see the Troubleshooting Manual .
